proof_topology: Assume a normalized a=0, Q6=0 physical incidence point on D(Omega*Delta) with rank(A)<=6.
The exact GLD75/GLD86 bridge, B_incidence=0, and C_center[8]=1 make the full GLD71 syndrome rank at most six.
Split on the polynomial H2deg=2*p^2-2*p+1; these two cases exhaust every complex point.
If H2deg!=0, GLD104 applies on D(H2deg*Delta) and forces B_offset=C_offset=0.
Zero offsets identify the written GLD88/F88 endpoint with the same a,p,q and Q6 values.
GLD95 excludes that endpoint on D(Omega*Delta), contradicting the assumed physical incidence point.
If H2deg=0, GLD99 directly excludes the physical incidence on D(Omega*Delta), for arbitrary a and hence at a=0.
Both exhaustive cases are impossible, proving only the normalized GLD105 physical-incidence statement; every listed wider obligation remains open.
